mutations.name: LR-NOREAP
mutations._mechanism: skill-candidates exec-pane leak row: the finalizer reports leaks but never kills them; the orphan must survive and the end-to-end test must see it.

mutations.name: LR-NOSCAN
mutations._mechanism: the finalizer never looks: leaked is always empty, so nothing is reported or reaped.

mutations.name: LR-ANCESTRY
mutations._mechanism: drop the ancestry exclusion: the reaper may match its own process tree.
